name: prism-monorepo
description: PRISM — Windows disk analyzer (Electron + React + TypeScript + Vite, Rust core engine). Internal codename; shipping name is an owner decision (docs/00-INDEX.md).

scripts.build: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter ui build && pnpm --filter desktop build && pnpm --filter license-server build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter shared test && pnpm --filter ui test && pnpm --filter license-server test && pnpm --filter desktop test
scripts.codegen: cargo run -p prism-types -- emit-ts packages/shared/src/generated/ && pnpm --filter shared gen:zod
